sn22.154:1.2: Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa micchādiṭṭhi uppajjatī ti || || 4
sn22.154:1.4: Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpam abhinivissa micchādiṭṭhi uppajjati || || 6-9
sn22.154:1.8: Viññāṇe sati viññānaṃ upādāya viññāṇam abhinivissa micchādiṭṭhi uppajjati || || 10
sn22.154:1.10: Rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.154:1.13: api nu tam anupādāya micchādiṭṭhi uppajjeyyā ti || ||
sn22.154:1.20: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkham vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.154:1.22: Yam panāniccam dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ || api nu tam anupādāya micchādiṭṭhi uppajjeyyāti || ||
